summary: Add meal-management write commands (meal set/set-all/confirm/skip, reorder) wrapping Forkable's replacePiece/replaceAllPieces/confirmDelivery/removeDelivery GraphQL mutations.
reason: Forkable auto-selects meals and has no placeOrder mutation; the read-only generated CLI could not set, confirm, or skip a meal. Mutations discovered statically from the forkable.com SPA bundle. All commands are dry-run by default, mutate only with --confirm, and short-circuit under PRINTING_PRESS_VERIFY=1.
validated_outcome: Placed a real order live (Loaded Burrito Box + Beef Bulgogi protein on delivery 1219483); replacePiece returned errors:null and the selection verified on read-back.
